response.sql: WITH pair_rates AS (SELECT o.mktnote, AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS avg_net_fee_rate FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault COLLATE BINARY = f.orderslink COLLATE BINARY GROUP BY o.mktnote), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) AS rate FROM pair_rates) SELECT AVG(p.avg_net_fee_rate) AS avg_net_fee_rate, AVG(p.avg_net_fee_rate - b.rate) AS avg_excess_rate FROM pair_rates AS p CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE p.avg_net_fee_rate > b.rate;
